cross_skill_findings.issue: Five AI Skills; the router-only one adds a hop without design value.

cross_skill_findings.issue: Four provider-config Skills share an identical skeleton; separation is sound but discriminators are missing in two.

cross_skill_findings.issue: Three analysis Skills with partial anti-triggers.

cross_skill_findings.issue: Three routing-shaped Skills plus the V2 router; ownership of 'which capability next' is split four ways.

cross_skill_findings.issue: Five plan reviewers; boundaries are sound but only partially cross-referenced.
